[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Thomas Glasgow graduated from Edinburgh University, 20 March 1670<ref>[https://archive.org/details/catalogueofgr10600univuoft/page/100/mode/2up Graduates in the Faculties of Arts, Divinity, and Law, Of the University of Edinburgh]</ref>

His father is assumed basd on location.

== Research Notes ==
A possible identification concerns Thomas Glasgow. The banns/marriage index records Thomas Glasgow and Gyles Spence on 24 July 1679 at Carstairs.<ref>Scotland’s People: Old Parish Registers — banns and marriages: OPR 633/10 / 37; [https://www.scotlandspeople.gov.uk/ record].</ref> The original parish register image has not been inspected. The combined index date does not by itself identify the precise event type. The identification remains uncertain.

=== Lifford identity comparison ===

Thomas, the Edinburgh M.A. of1670, is a surviving possible identity for [[Glasgow-3556|Thomas Glasgow of Lifford]], at22% subjective confidence. The educated adult generation fits the1684–1701 Donegal occurrences, but no shared holding, locality or associate links the men. His existing attachment to [[Glasgow-3187|Thomas Glasgow of Edinburgh]] is unproved and does not exclude the comparison with [[Glasgow-1101|Archibald Glasgow’s]] eldest son. Neither identity nor a replacement father is selected, and the separate profiles are retained. The graduate and the person in the Carstairs marriage of1679 are also distinct record roles until connected.
